action.new_text:
"""Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Validate inputs
    for name, arr in [("logp_with_result", logp_with_result),
                      ("logp_call_only", logp_call_only),
                      ("logp_no_call", logp_no_call)]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy ndarray, got {type(arr)}")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix, got ndim={arr.ndim}")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.issubdtype(arr.dtype, np.floating):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be floating dtype, got {arr.dtype}")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be nonpositive, found positive values")
    # Check shape consistency
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All log probability matrices must have the same shape")
    # Check tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean value")
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be numeric")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
    if tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")

    n_candidates, horizon = logp_with_result.shape
    # Compute normalized weights
    t = np.arange(horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    if np.sum(raw_weights) == 0:
        norm_weights = raw_weights
    else:
        norm_weights = raw_weights / np.sum(raw_weights)

    # Compute weighted losses
    loss_with_result = -np.sum(norm_weights[np.newaxis, :] * logp_with_result, axis=1)
    loss_call_only = -np.sum(norm_weights[np.newaxis, :] * logp_call_only, axis=1)
    loss_no_call = -np.sum(norm_weights[np.newaxis, :] * logp_no_call, axis=1)

    # L_minus = min(L_empty, L_call_only)
    L_minus = np.minimum(loss_no_call, loss_call_only)

    # Margin = L_minus - L_plus
    margin = L_minus - loss_with_result

    # Keep if margin >= tau_filter
    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep, margin
